title: REQ · the-boys-room content lives in src/content/worlds and is schema-validated on load
summary: Move and adapt the-boys-room content, loader validates
description: Context: content is at game/content/worlds/the-boys-room, read by loader.ts and by the frontend import.meta.glob. Desired behavior: files move to game/src/content/worlds/the-boys-room with each object given asset, position, scale, layer, interactionBounds; loadWorld validates via schema. Expected result: loadWorld on the new dir succeeds, malformed scenes fail with a path-named error. Why: content separated from engine in the target structure.
acceptance_criteria: Given the new directory, when loadWorld runs, then six bedroom objects load each with a layer and position
Given a scene object lacking position, when loadWorld runs, then it throws naming the field path
Given the old game/content directory, then it no longer exists
technical_constraints: Object ids unchanged: bed, bookshelf, desk, old-computer, window, door
